faqQuestion1: How do I create a listing?
faqAnswer1: To create a listing, tap the 'Sell/Trade' tab, fill in your item details, add photos, and tap 'Post Listing'. Make sure to include clear photos and accurate descriptions.
faqQuestion2: Is it safe to buy and sell on this platform?
faqAnswer2: Yes! We recommend meeting in public places, verifying items before payment, and using our verification system. Never send money upfront and report any suspicious activity.
faqQuestion3: How do I verify my account?
faqAnswer3: Go to Settings > Verification. You can verify your phone number and upload ID documents. Verified accounts build more trust with other users.
faqAnswer4: We support cash transactions, mobile money (MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money), and bank transfers. Always verify payment before releasing items.
faqQuestion5: How do I report a scam or suspicious activity?
faqAnswer5: Use the 'Report Scam' feature in the app, or go to Settings > Help & Support > Report an Issue. Include photos/videos as evidence when possible.

safetyTipText: Meet in public places, verify items before payment, never send money upfront.
safetyTip1: Always meet in public places like shopping centers, banks, or busy areas.
safetyTip2: Inspect items carefully before making any payment.
safetyTip3: Never send money upfront or pay before seeing the item.
safetyTip4: Trust your instincts - if something feels wrong, walk away.
safetyTip5: Use secure payment methods and avoid cash when possible.
safetyTip6: Bring a friend when meeting strangers for transactions.
safetyTip7: Verify seller identity and check their ratings/reviews.
safetyTip8: Report suspicious activity or scam attempts immediately.
